title: continuous-batcher: scheduler tuning for queueing, fairness, starvation prevention and timeouts
author: Priya Patel
description: Motivation: continuous-batcher scheduler was occasionally allowing long-tail requests to starve lower-priority tenants and exhibited transient queueing backpressure that increased p95 latency under bursty traffic. This PR tunes the scheduler to improve fairness and prevent starvation while keeping throughput and tail-latency targets. Summary of changes: 1) introduce max_queue_time_ms (default 20ms) and per-client in-flight queue cap to bound waiting time; 2) implement a fairness window with age-based priority bumping to avoid starvation for low-weight queues; 3) add a starvation detector that escalates pending requests into a fast-path preemption queue after configurable threshold; 4) better request timeout handling to surface KV-cache misses earlier and avoid holding batch slots; 5) add metrics and traces for queue_time, preemption_count, starvation_events, per-client queue depth; 6) expose new knobs behind a feature-flagged config and provide safe defaults; 7) CI/perf harness changes and unit/integration tests. Design notes: changes live under scheduler/continuous_batcher/* and are opt-in via FEATURE_CONT_BATCHER_SCHED_TUNING. The preemption path is conservative: it only preempts requests that have waited more than starvation_threshold_ms and when a high-utilization signal is present. Timeout behavior was changed so that KV cache lookup timeouts return a fast-fail to the caller allowing retry on fallback model variants. Testing and validation: synthetic workload tests (spike bursts, multi-tenant mixes) show p50 -6% p95 -4% and throughput +12% on our internal perf lab; starvation events observed in previous runs are reduced by ~99% in long-tail microbenchmarks. Rollout plan: gated feature-flag rollout to canary pool for 48h, monitor queue_time and error spikes, gradually enable across Dedicated and Hosted. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve existing behavior; no breaking API changes. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] perf benchmarks, [x] docs update, [x] feature flag gating, [x] alerting added.

release_notes: Improve continuous-batcher scheduler fairness and starvation prevention. Introduce configurable queueing knobs (max_queue_time_ms, starvation_wait_ms, per_client_queue_cap), an age-based fairness window, and a conservative preemption fast-path to avoid long-tail starvation. All features are behind a feature flag and default to preserve existing behavior.
notes: Follow-up work: fine-tune default knobs based on Dedicated workload telemetry, add adaptive knob that adjusts max_queue_time_ms based on observed latency distributions, and extend observability to include per-tenant fairness scoring.
